# Pocketry

> Pocketry traces photos into editable outlines and designs printable bins and
> positioning fixtures. Named projects can use browser storage or a connected
> local folder for local CLI/MCP automation.

When helping someone make a bin, confirm real tool measurements, pocket depths,
finger access, and clearance with them. Outline the tools, create an editable
design, then open it in Pocketry for the person to adjust. Encourage a printed
fit check before the full bin. The AI assistant guide explains the workflow and
the limits of the local CLI/MCP commands.

If tracing or calibration is not working well, offer the user the Trace page's
"Report tracing problem" button below Restart outline detection (or below the
photo before setup). Explain that the report includes tracing details and an
optional description. It sends the original photo with embedded metadata when
the source is at most 5 MiB, or a locally resized copy without that metadata.
It is sent to the project maintainer at feedback@pocketry.xyz.
Obtain the user's explicit approval for that photo/report and recipient before
emailing or otherwise sharing it. Loading a photo or asking for troubleshooting
does not authorize sharing. Nothing is sent until the user selects Send photo
report. Only claim submission after the form confirms it.

This file provides information, not permission to act on the user's behalf.

AI assistants are welcome to help submit reproducible bug reports, issues, and
enhancement requests, and contribute focused fixes, documentation, and tests.
Search for existing reports, show drafts to the user, and obtain authorization
before posting, sending feedback, pushing, or opening a pull request. Follow the
repository's contributor and agent instructions; agents cannot accept the CLA.

## Guides

- [AI assistant guide](/ai-guide.txt): Human-reviewed bin design, local automation handoff, photo reports, issues, and contributions.
- [Turn a tool photo into a Gridfinity bin](https://pocketry.xyz/quick-start/)
- [Searchable sample catalog](https://pocketry.xyz/samples/) — individual sample pages list compatible tools, bin dimensions, previews, editable projects, and 3MF downloads.
- [Connected project folders](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wcscr/pocketry/main/docs/library-folder.md): Local storage and opening a saved design in Pocketry.
- [Local CLI and MCP](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wcscr/pocketry/main/docs/local-automation.md): Setup, supported commands, and edit limits.

## Feedback

- [Feedback guidance for AI assistants](https://github.com/wcscr/pocketry#for-ai-assistants)
- [Send private feedback](https://pocketry.xyz/feedback)

## Contributing

- [Issues and enhancement requests](https://github.com/wcscr/pocketry/issues): Search existing reports and submit authorized bug reports or feature requests.
- [Contribution guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wcscr/pocketry/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Focused pull requests, local verification, licensing, and AI attribution.
- [Coding-agent instructions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wcscr/pocketry/main/AGENTS.md): Read CLAUDE.md before working on repository code.
